user.title: Nokia GPON router
user.description: The router's TLS certificate is self-signed; the certificate presented now will be trusted from here on.

reauth_confirm.title: Router rejected the login
reauth_confirm.description: The router at {host} rejected the password. This also happens when the account is temporarily locked after failed logins (e.g. typos in the browser); wait a few minutes before retrying.

reauth_certificate.title: Router certificate changed
reauth_certificate.description:
The router at {host} presents a different TLS certificate than the trusted one (or none is trusted yet), so the password was not sent.

Previously trusted:
`{old_fingerprint}`

Presented now:
`{new_fingerprint}`

This is expected after a router firmware update or factory reset. If neither happened, someone on your network may be intercepting the connection: do not continue. You can compare the fingerprint with the certificate shown by your browser at {router_url}.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the router web UI.
error.invalid_auth: Router rejected the username or password. Note: the router locks logins after several failed attempts.
error.certificate_changed: The router's certificate changed while logging in.
error.certificate_not_trusted: Confirm that you trust the new certificate.
error.unknown: Unexpected error, see the Home Assistant log.
error.certificate_changed_again: The certificate changed again; check the new fingerprint below.
